body:
## Context
DM-438 from the OMP epic (ep_01m6fk7esyy6anvw84fv0e0b4j, sprint 2), moved here because the run is at its final checkpoint and cannot claim tickets. Work on top of branch omp-terminal (PR #16).

DM-409 classifies OMP's sign-in from `omp usage --json`: signed out was recorded (empty lists, exit 0), but the signed-in shape comes from OMP's source (`usage-cli.ts`), and a signed-in run fetches live usage over the network, which may exceed `STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS.omp` (10 s) and show "unknown". The person is now signed in (`omp login`, Anthropic).

## Do
- Record `omp usage --json` signed in (exit code, timing over 5 runs, and the JSON with any account identifiers redacted) into docs/reports/omp-cli.md section 5.
- If the shape differs from the classifier's assumption, fix `classifyOmp`; set `STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS.omp` to cover the slowest observed run with margin (or switch to a cheaper status command the recording shows).

## Tests
- agentAuth.test.ts: the recorded (redacted) signed-in output classifies as signed_in.
title: Record signed-in OMP status and size its timeout (DM-438)
